meta.name: alterlab-neuropixels
meta.description: Analyze Neuropixels 1.0/2.0 extracellular electrophysiology with SpikeInterface — load SpikeGLX/Open Ephys recordings, preprocess and motion-correct, run Kilosort4 spike sorting, compute quality metrics, apply Allen/IBL curation, and do AI-assisted visual inspection. Use when working with neural recordings, spike sorting, or extracellular electrophysiology, or when the user mentions Neuropixels, SpikeGLX, Open Ephys, Kilosort, quality metrics, or unit curation. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能分析 Neuropixels 神经电生理数据：加载 SpikeGLX/Open Ephys 等格式，预处理、运动校正，运行 Kilosort4 等 spike sorting，计算质量指标，按 Allen/IBL 标准筛选，并辅助人工检查。
howto.when: 当用户提到 Neuropixels、SpikeGLX、Open Ephys、Kilosort、质量指标或单元筛选等关键词，或要求分析神经记录、spike sorting 时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个 SpikeGLX 文件夹的神经数据。
say.note: Claude 会加载数据并运行完整分析流程。

say.text: 对这段记录做运动校正并运行 Kilosort4。
用 Allen 标准筛选出高质量单元。
say.note: Claude 会计算质量指标并应用 Allen 筛选规则。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze Neuropixels neural recordings: load SpikeGLX/Open Ephys formats, preprocess, motion-correct, run Kilosort4 spike sorting, compute quality metrics, curate units using Allen/IBL criteria, and assist visual inspection.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions Neuropixels, SpikeGLX, Open Ephys, Kilosort, quality metrics, or unit curation, or asks to analyze neural recordings or perform spike sorting.

say_en.text: Analyze this SpikeGLX folder of neural data.
say_en.note: Claude will load data and run the full pipeline.

say_en.text: Motion-correct this recording and run Kilosort4.
say_en.note: Claude will check drift, correct motion, then run spike sorting.
Claude will compute metrics and apply Allen curation rules.
